limitations_admitted.value: Different member selections and spectroscopic coverage across the three protoclusters make the comparison uncertain

evidence.loc: Comparative Analyses: AGN population in MQN01, SSA22 and Spiderweb protoclusters
evidence.quote: prevent the possibility to use consistent physical method to derive comparable volumes, and imply that the comparison should be taken with some caution.

limitations_admitted.value: Small number statistics (Poisson uncertainties) limit conclusions on environmental effects

evidence.loc: Summary and Conclusions
evidence.quote: In the analyses presented in this paper, Poissonian uncertainties provide a challenge for the determination of the role of environmental factors and galaxy properties on SMBH accretion and growth.

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA plays a minor role (redshifts and member identification); the headline results rest on Chandra and on unpublished MUSE member and SED catalogs
Only six AGN in a volume chosen to maximise the MQN01 count, and for SSA22 and Spiderweb the volume was centered to maximise AGN, so overdensities may be biased high
Comparison with other protoclusters mixes heterogeneous selections and M*/SFR methods
delta16 uses a single field HXLF (Gilli07) with no incompleteness correction
MQN01 centered on a QSO by construction, so overdensity and radial trends may reflect that choice

missing_for_reproduction: Galbiati et al. (in prep.) MUSE member catalog and SED-fit M*, SFR (needed for f_AGN and sBHAR)
ALMA reduction, imaging and line fluxes (in Pensabene24)
Chandra ObsIDs are listed but archive access/data availability is not stated
Source catalog and spectral-extraction regions are not tabulated beyond six sources
KDE bandwidth, bootstrap sizes and random seeds
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Chandra: 22 ObsIDs (~634 ks), a few GB. ALMA: Band 3 and Band 6 12-m data of one project; size not stated, and not required for the X-ray analysis beyond the published redshifts.
reproducibility.score_reason: The Chandra reduction and spectral recipe is fairly detailed, but key inputs (MUSE member catalog, SED masses and SFR) come from unpublished work, ALMA processing is deferred to another paper, and data availability is not stated.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA is a minor supporting dataset here, the main results depend on in-prep catalogs, and public availability of the data is not stated.

methods_papers.why: ALMA observations and analysis of the MQN01 field (CO emitters and QSO redshift)
sBHAR definition, k_bol and field accretion-rate distributions
Spiderweb Chandra analysis and HXLF method followed here

companion_papers.why: MUSE protocluster members and SED fitting of host galaxies
Extended Lya nebula in the MQN01 field
ALMA CO(4-3) emitters in the same field
